correctness.rationale: Deleting one braid hyperplane merges exactly pairs of chambers with adjacent incomparable labels. Boundary mergers are unimodular, interior mergers split integrally as a 3-dimensional four-ray square cone times an orthant. Explicit dual-semigroup Hilbert basis and primitive binomial relation give k[u,v,w,z]/(uv-wz). Proper faces are unimodular, all minimal singular cones are indexed by nonempty proper subsets of the remaining n-2 labels, and each star quotient is an integral product of braid fans. Independent exact small-n checker passes for n=4..7. The symbolic argument, not finite extrapolation, proves the all-n result.

The n=4 special case is already within a previously counted fan fixed-point family; this count is not claimed independently. value.rationale: The minimum deletion perturbation of the smooth permutohedral fan produces exponentially many pairwise disjoint smooth codimension-three singular strata, with exact permutohedral product structures and uniform ordinary-double-point transverse slices. The theorem gives complete local-to-global geometry and closed fixed-point counts for an infinite family; these are not routine consequences of detecting that the graph is nonsimple.
